candidates.title: Index incoming school documents

demandEvidence.chore: hantering av post och inkommande dokument
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: hantering av post och inkommande dokument

ease.reason: A mock index from fictional documents is approachable; the notice gives no metadata scheme or attached implementation reference.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: a school office might value less filing effort; this paid human role proves no AI service demand.

feasibility.reason: A two-week mock can label operator supplied fictional documents and draft an index; real records and retention rules remain out of scope.

autonomy.reason: A draft index can repeat from supplied files; staff must verify labels and decide where records are stored.

evidence.reason: The primary notice names incoming document handling and school document archiving, but no format, cadence or software capability.

candidates.reason: Assessed a fictional document-indexing mock; mean 4.6 is below threshold. The notice establishes handling and archiving chores, but not formats or implementation support.

candidates.title: Draft a school schedule change

ease.reason: A synthetic schedule-change mock is possible, but the notice gives no rules and no attached implementation reference supports it.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: a school might value less schedule administration; this paid human role does not establish AI service demand.

feasibility.reason: A two-week demo could draft one proposed schedule change from fictional inputs; real student records and adaptation decisions are excluded.

autonomy.reason: A system could format a draft from supplied constraints; school staff must validate every constraint and approve changes.

evidence.reason: The primary notice explicitly names updating pupil schedules based on adaptations, but omits inputs, rules and software evidence.

candidates.reason: Assessed a fictional schedule-change draft; mean 4.0 is below threshold. The notice names the chore, but supplies no rules or implementation support; staff must approve all changes.

autonomy.reason: The template supports extraction and sheet logging; staff must verify each field and make coding or approval decisions.
